verdict.rationale: Apify documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents and LLMs discover and use Actors, and a probe confirms a dedicated MCP integration page in the official docs. Evidence of setup, transport, auth and exposed tools is thin. Missing for 10: details on connection setup/auth and transports, enumeration of exposed MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
